animations.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production arcade fighting-game sprite sheet, Rui locomotion animations.
Input image 1: Rui identity and outfit REFERENCE; input image 2: Rui in-game outfit and Firewall Punch REFERENCE. Generate NEW complete animation poses, not a collage of the references.
Identity invariants: EXACT SAME Rui in every frame: adult stocky muscular bald man, black rectangular eyeglasses, full short gray beard and moustache, gray headphones around neck, pale blue pinstriped shirt rolled sleeves, brown tactical utility vest with small coordination/IT chest badge and pouches, dark blue jeans, brown lace-up work boots, silver mechanical gauntlet with gold bands on his right arm, flexible black tube loops to a small brass cylinder behind shoulder, bare left hand. Preserve face proportions and costume without redesign. Combat hands are free; NO handheld tablet, briefcase, padlock, shield, cape, weapons, second character or costume changes.
Style: consistent high quality 2D illustrated arcade sprites with crisp ink outlines and shaded volumes matching references, detailed readable face, combat animation quality matching Monteiro and Yafa. Facing RIGHT throughout, orthographic side/three-quarter fighting view.
Layout: canvas 1536 x 1024, EXACTLY 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows; 24 COMPLETE full-body independent silhouettes. Each 256 x 256 cell holds ONE entire pose; body roughly 205 pixels high at neutral guard. Every arm, boot, tube and effect must fit inside its OWN cell with at least 22px transparent margin. Prone/kicking/wide poses must be compact enough to fit with transparent gaps; never touch neighbouring sprites. Fixed camera, consistent body scale, clean floor baseline, same character proportions. No perspective size changes, no frame lines, labels, captions, numbers or typography outside tiny outfit badge. Background MUST be actually transparent RGBA; no gradient or scenery. Small glow only tightly attached to gauntlet in special rows; no effects in other groups.
Each row is one six-frame animation in reading order, start/load/action peak at COLUMN FOUR/recovery/finish. Every consecutive pose must differ meaningfully, smooth connective motion.
ROW 1: Idle fighting guard: six distinct gentle breathing poses, gauntlet near chest and bare hand protecting face.
ROW 2: Walk forward: a complete alternating-leg walking cycle, two contact steps and two passing poses.
ROW 3: Run forward after double tap: leaning torso, vigorous alternating legs, complete cycle.
ROW 4: Backhop after double back tap: crouch/load, takeoff, compact airborne backward retreat, land, second quick recoil hop, land.
Never crop or join sprites; don't duplicate idle pose as a whole movement cycle. Prioritize intact separately extractable bodies and consistent identity.
